class NumericClassIndexes {
  [key:string]:string|number;
  [key:number]:number;
  value='text';
  0=1;
}
class PatternClassIndexes {
  [key:string]:string|number;
  [key:`data-${string}`]:number;
  ['data-n']=2;
}
class ValidInheritedClassIndexes extends NumericClassIndexes { 1=3; }
console.log(new NumericClassIndexes(), new PatternClassIndexes(), new ValidInheritedClassIndexes());
